title: RDPFIX
description: 解决在rdp环境下，由于minecraft只能识别相对坐标的鼠标移动导致的鼠标乱飘（视角向上）问题。Solves the issue where the cursor drifts erratically (camera keeps moving upward) in Minecraft under an RDP environment, caused by the game only recognizing relative mouse movements.
body:
解决在rdp环境下，由于minecraft只能识别相对坐标的鼠标移动导致的鼠标乱飘（视角向上）问题

Solves the issue where the cursor drifts erratically (camera keeps moving upward) in Minecraft under an RDP environment, caused by the game only recognizing relative mouse movements.

相关内容可以查看[https://mojira.dev/MC-126875](https://mojira.dev/MC-126875)
